description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: Name Anthropic SDK client instances `client` — e.g. `const client = new Anthropic();` in TypeScript, `client = Anthropic()` in Python. This applies to source files and code snippets in READMEs and guides alike.

Never use the "CMA" acronym. Write "Managed Agents" or "Claude Managed Agents" in prose and comments, and spell it out in identifiers, file names, and log prefixes (e.g. `managed-agents.ts`, not `cma.ts`; `[managed-agent]`, not `[cma]`).
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
